title: "I'm getting involved": Welcome to Plathville stars Ethan and Moriah discuss Lydia's wedding - NewsBreak
text: The latest Welcome to Plathville, Season 7, Episode 2, was released on July 29, 2025. The TLC show featured many significant incidents in the episode, including Veronica calling Olivia while Zac felt like an outsider. Additionally, the episode also saw Kim opening up about getting a part-time job and her DUI. One of the incidents featured on the latest episode was the meeting between siblings Ethan and Moriah. The two talked about Lydia's wedding. After talking about how it's only been three months since Lydia and Zac met, Ethan asked Moriah if she was getting involved. While she said no, she asked him the same question. On the contrary, Welcome to Plathville star Ethan said, he was going to get involved. The eldest son in the family, Ethan, met his sister Moriah. She is the second-oldest sibling in the family. While at the restaurant, Ethan asked Moriah about Lydia's wedding. Listening to her brother, Welcome to Plathville star was confused at first. When she asked about the "NASCAR" part, Ethan said it was "so fast". Moriah agreed and said it was quite fast. Ethan responded with, The two talked about how Ethan and Zac met three months ago. Answering Ethan's question, Moriah said she was going to "observe" and not get involved . When she enquired about the same, Ethan said that he was going to get involved. Welcome to Plathville star added that he and Micah decided to give Zac "hell" and observe if he sticks around. Moriah asked what would happen after Zac passes the test and sticks around. Ethan, therefore, referred to it as the "admission fee". In her private confession, Moriah shared: While Moriah was determined to stay "out of it," Ethan said he would get involved. But he stated that he wasn't the one who would be married to Zac and see him every day. Both the siblings laughed about it. Further into their conversation, Welcome to Plathville star Moriah thanked her brother. She admitted that lately she hadn't been feeling like talking to anybody. However, whenever she had thoughts about talking to somebody, it would be him. Ethan confessed, Ethan noted that Moriah and Veronica were still on speaking terms. He asked if Moriah had reached out to Veronica, and she said she didn't know what to do. He told her to apologize to people she had hurt, while she talked about her confusion.
